human_decision_reason: BK/Human Creative Owner must accept or reject the placeholder visual/readability quality gate before Implementation Agent uses the Art note for a Godot change.
acceptance_criteria: The Work Package authorizes exactly one Art Agent placeholder/readability note and one Art Run record.
The art note is constrained to player silhouette, heading/facing cue, ground/motion reference cue, and contrast constraints.
The art note contains concrete BK review criteria for placeholder quality, but does not claim BK approval.
No actual assets are generated or committed, and no Godot, schema, agent profile, research note, or Learning Card files are modified.
The handoff targets match the Art Agent handoff paths allowed by agents/HANDOFF_MAP.md.
notes: This Work Package tests the Research -> Art handoff only. It intentionally leaves Art -> Implementation execution blocked until BK completes the placeholder quality gate.
